page: Amazon Web Services c9g.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the AWS Graviton processor family. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on the arm64 architecture, utilizing the AWS Neoverse-V3 CPU model running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Because the threads-per-core ratio is 1.0, each of the 32 vCPUs corresponds to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource sharing at the hardware thread level.

The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local NVMe storage, meaning storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 17 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

The Neoverse-V3 processor includes a cache hierarchy consisting of a 64 KB L1 data cache, a 2 MB L2 cache, and a 48 MB L3 cache. Hardware-accelerated cryptography is supported via AES instructions, though other advanced vector and matrix extensions are absent. This hardware profile is designed for compute-intensive workloads such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and CPU-bound application servers that benefit from dedicated ARM-based execution resources.
